title: Coupler Static Attributes
description: Distances are in meters, forces in newtons, angles in degrees and speeds in meters per second. Rearm distance = max(capture_distance, rearm_distance_multiplier × lock_distance).

capture_distance.description: Capture range: closure force is applied while the endpoint distance stays within it.

lock_distance.description: Lock window: the connection is committed while the endpoint distance stays within it; it must not exceed capture_distance.

max_capture_force.description: Cap of the closure force in newtons. 0 closes only through existing actuators or outside forces.

lock_angle_tolerance.description: Allowed error between the two facing normals in degrees.

max_lock_speed.description: Allowed relative speed of the two endpoints at lock time, in meters per second.

rearm_distance_multiplier.description: Rearm distance multiplier; the product must be finite.

on_attach.description: Sound played once when the coupler latches.

on_detach.description: Sound played once when the coupler releases.

sounds.description: Basic lifecycle sounds plus one latch sound and one release sound; both default to the vanilla tripwire attach event.
